episodes.name: Where the Sun Rises
episodes.overview: Forty-eight contestants from eight countries arrive and the teams size each other up. At last, the curtain rises on the first quest.

episodes.name: On the Brink
episodes.overview: Athletes race, push and grapple atop a sinking slope. After grueling, deadlocked matches, two countries face off without making any concessions.

episodes.name: Shipwreck
episodes.overview: One nation claims a powerful privilege. In their test of speed and teamwork, players race through a giant shipwreck across a rugged obstacle course.

episodes.name: Desperate Prayer
episodes.overview: After a wild, intense race through the shipwreck, the next quest unfolds in a new arena — where the results from the previous match are crucial.

episodes.name: Mysterious Village
episodes.overview: Players tap into their sports skills for battle. As the third quest looms, teams prepare to pick formidable reps as each win rides on smart match-ups.

episodes.name: Insurmountable Wall
episodes.overview: Racing against time and heavy loads, teams face more than a contest — it's a true test of endurance. Losing teams must break their own torsos right away.

episodes.name: For the Homeland
episodes.overview: In a seemingly endless game, one contestant demonstrates extraordinary ease and skill in the hanging game. Can the other competitor win by imitation?

episodes.name: Formidable Foe
episodes.overview: No mistakes are permitted as time continues to run out. With only half the teams left, the results of an early poll return to haunt the contestants.

episodes.name: Inescapable Hell
episodes.overview: This brutal challenge demands arm strength, tenacity, speed and precision. One team catches their competitors off guard with a surprise move.

episodes.name: Charge
episodes.overview: Shackles. Giant pillars. Iron balls. The teams are summoned to a hellish game where mental endurance is more important than ever.

episodes.name: Impenetrable Fortress
episodes.overview: Teams give their all in a grueling test of stamina and tactics. As daunting challenges push them to the limit, who will endure and make it to the end?

episodes.name: All-Out Battle
episodes.overview: As exhaustion and determination peak, the finalists enter the arena for an intense all-out battle. The victor will claim glory and a hefty cash prize.
